verdict.rationale: A chip normally isn't judged on API versioning, but the evidence shows M5 is programmed through a numbered API generation (Tensor APIs in Metal 4, plus Core ML and Foundation Models), which makes the axis applicable. That only implies versioning, and nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy, compatibility guarantees or versioning practices. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, explicit API versioning and compatibility guarantees, migration guidance, independent corroboration.
